text:
sam: Quick heads-up — new tenant 'Orion' will start onboarding next week. They need dedicated p5/p4d capacity in eu-west-6 and a smaller g5 pool in ap-southeast-6. Can we lift quotas and check ENI/IP headroom?

emily: Which AWS accounts and org units are we talking about? need account IDs and target AZs to open support cases.

sam: Account IDs: 987654321098 (orion-prod), 987654321099 (orion-staging). Target AZs: eu-west-6a/b, ap-southeast-6a. Timeline: pilot traffic Mon-Wed next week, full ramp over 2 weeks.

zhou: FYI, ENI and IPv4 pool in those regions are tight. For p5/p4d we'll likely need EC2 On-Demand-PrivateAccelerators and EC2 ElasticNetworkInterface increases. Also check NAT Gateway EIP pool if they route outbound via shared NAT.

cloud-ops: Please include the current quota numbers you want increased (e.g., Running On-Demand Accelerator (p4d) -> from X to Y). Support asks for exact values + business justification.

sam: Proposed numbers: p5 instances (accelerator count) -> 40, p4d -> 20, g5 (g5.12x/24x) -> 60. ENI quota bump -> +500. EIPs for NAT -> +30. Justification: production inference fleet for Redwood Dedicated tenant, 99.9% SLOs, staged rollout to avoid cold starts.

emily: Can you also paste the Service Quotas CLI snippets? I can submit the requests and attach the tenant contract to speed up approvals.

sam: Sure — example for p5:
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-6AC0AB64 --desired-value 40 --region eu-west-6
```
For ENI: quota-code L-xxxx (we mapped earlier) — will attach exact code in the case.

infra-bot: New support case created: CASE-2026-ORION-8745. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/?displayId=CASE-2026-ORION-8745

maria: I'll triage networking: subnet IPs, route tables, and NATs. If we need extra /26s for worker subnets, tell me how many. Also consider IPv6 fallback if IPv4 scarce.

sam: Recommend two /26 per AZ for GPU pools (reserve for scale + node replacement) — so +6 /26s for eu-west-6 and +3 /26s for ap-southeast-6. IPv6: enabled on VPC but some partner infra isn't ready; prefer IPv4 primary.

zhou: Reminder: p4d/p5 placements often require specific instance families per AZ; we should ask AWS to reserve capacity or approve placements for those AZs. Also request ENI quotas per AZ where supported.

cloud-ops: Cost note: if we commit reserved capacity (1y partial) for p5 it reduces unit cost by ~30%. Do we want to propose reserved vs on-demand?

sam: For pilot, on-demand. After 2w ramp, if utilization >70% we'll discuss 1y partial reservation for core fleet. I'll add cost forecast to the case.

emily: Submitted cases for eu-west-6 and ap-southeast-6 with the numbers above. AWS asked for monthly expected vCPU/accelerator hours — I put projected steady-state 700k accelerator-hours/month for eu-west-6.

infra-bot: Case update: AWS responded asking for AZ-level placement info and confirmation of VPC subnet expansions. They've asked to confirm NAT EIP usage and whether cross-account ENI usage is expected.

maria: I'm creating the subnet change PR and will include tagging and route policy. I'll also confirm whether shared NAT will cover EIP counts or we need dedicated NAT for Orion.

sam: Thanks — ping me when PR is up. If AWS can't approve immediate placements, fallback plan is to route Orion to our eu-west-4 pilot pool and queue capacity ramp for eu-west-6. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
